title: Grateful Dead Live at Oklahoma City Music Hall on 1972-11-15
lineage: Dat -> Pro Tools -> Samplitude Professional v10.02 -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Superb soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1972 set featuring a smoking Playing in the Band and standout renditions of Brokedown Palace, Mexicali, Me & Bobby McGee, and Wharf Rat.
ai_review.review: The recording is an excellent soundboard (Charlie Miller) mix with crystal‑clear separation that lets Jerry’s legendary guitar work shine. The show bursts with high energy – a monster Playing in the Band, tight transitions, and memorable performances of Brokedown Palace, Mexicali, Me & Bobby McGee, and an exceptional Wharf Rat. Keyboardist Keith Godchaux also receives praise for his playing.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (5‑star and 4‑star) highlight outstanding musical performance and excellent soundboard quality; weighted average of show (≈4.2) and recording (≈4.8) yields ~4.4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Charlie Miller mix praised as superb, with stellar clarity, excellent instrument separation, and no noted dropouts or major flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set described as a bit thin overall but still high‑energy with tight transitions and a powerful finish; the show maintains strong momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for smoking his guitar (Tiger/Strat), delivering fluid, fabulous notes that "drip" and carry the performance.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux’s playing is called exceptional, adding to the tightness of the set.
